crazing.cause: Thermal tensile stress from rapid uneven mold and secondary spray cooling during casting

causes_by_pattern.isolated: Localized thermal gradient from uneven mold flux lubrication during casting
causes_by_pattern.clustered: Severe thermal tensile stress from clogged secondary cooling spray nozzles

actions.Low: Log coil ID and verify secondary cooling spray nozzle alignment at next stop
actions.Medium: Hold coil for crack-depth check and inspect mold cooling water flow before next heat
actions.High: Quarantine coil immediately and replace blocked secondary cooling spray nozzles now

inclusion.cause: Non-metallic slag or refractory alumina particles entrapped in solidifying steel

causes_by_pattern.isolated: Detached alumina or refractory particle entrapped near strip subsurface
causes_by_pattern.clustered: Tundish slag vortexing or submerged entry nozzle shroud air re-oxidation

actions.Low: Log slab ID and check tundish slag flux powder depth at next heat change
actions.Medium: Flag slab batch for ultrasonic check and inspect submerged entry nozzle shroud seal
actions.High: Quarantine slab batch immediately and stabilize tundish bath level and slag flux now

patches.cause: Uneven pickling acid residue or rolling oil emulsion stain on strip surface

causes_by_pattern.isolated: Localized squeegee roll drip or residual rolling emulsion spot on strip
causes_by_pattern.clustered: Depleted pickling acid bath concentration and blocked cascade rinse spray headers

actions.Low: Log strip section and inspect wringer squeegee rolls at next coil weld
actions.Medium: Re-clean strip surface and check pickling rinse spray header pressure and acid titration
actions.High: Hold strip immediately, purge contaminated rinse tank and restore squeegee roll pressure now

pitted_surface.cause: Work-roll surface fatigue spalling or hard oxide debris indented into strip

causes_by_pattern.isolated: Loose hard oxide particle indented into strip at finishing stand nip
causes_by_pattern.clustered: Periodic work-roll surface fatigue spalling and worn roll-wiper brush assembly

actions.Low: Log part and inspect finishing stand work-roll surface at next scheduled stop
actions.Medium: Clean roll wiper brushes and inspect work rolls for cyclic pitting before next coil
actions.High: Quarantine sheet immediately and schedule work-roll change and roll re-grinding now

rolled-in_scale.cause: Incomplete high-pressure hydraulic descaling before hot-finishing rolling stands

causes_by_pattern.isolated: Residual secondary blister scale flake pressed into strip at roughing stand
causes_by_pattern.clustered: Low descaler header water pressure or clogged flat-fan descaling nozzles

actions.Low: Log sheet and check descaler header pressure gauge at next slab gap
actions.Medium: Flag sheet for surface conditioning and test descaler nozzle spray overlap pattern
actions.High: Quarantine sheet immediately, restore descaler pump pressure and clear blocked nozzles now

scratches.cause: Mechanical friction abrasion from misaligned entry guide rails or seized roller burrs

causes_by_pattern.isolated: Single sharp metal burr on entry side-guide liner rubbing moving strip
causes_by_pattern.clustered: Seized table roller or misaligned pinch-roll guide bar gouging strip surface

actions.Low: Log strip and inspect entry side-guide wear plates at next line pause
actions.Medium: Polish contact rollers and deburr conveyor guide rails before next coil
actions.High: Quarantine strip immediately, realign side guides and replace seized table roller now
